title: Result later — optional posted Slot to existing MarketingLead (park only)
description:
Park only — do not design a new CRM. Do not implement.

## Result later

Optional link from a posted Slot (or handed_off SharePayload) to an existing **MarketingLead**.

Inbound already exists: WaitlistSignup, MarketingLead, MarketingProgram/Step/Rule/Trigger, MarketingEnrollment, MarketingInteraction. Keep it. Do not replace it. Do not invent a parallel lead object.

When a hire conversation actually happens, a human may attach the Slot/Campaign to the lead. That is enough for v1 thinking. No schema, no UI, no auto-attribution.
